brief: Exactly three square head-and-shoulders radio portraits side by side on separate near-black umber backdrops. Dark serious Swedish 17th-century oil portrait chiaroscuro. Left: Ebba Grip from original top row, blonde crown braid, blue eyes, navy buttoned naval coat, tarnished gold and three-crowns gorget. Center: original Hedvig Rålamb, 55-year-old antiquarian, grey-brown pinned hair, weathered thoughtful face, wire spectacles on forehead, cream collar and bottle-green wool. Right: collector matching the specialist sheet bottom row, grey stubble, plain black broad-brim hat, black leather and steel. Large readable faces at 92px runtime, no text, borders, caricatures or glossy CGI.
